market.question: Will George Russell be the 2026 F1 Drivers' Champion?

assessment.reasoning: After 4 races in 2026, Russell trails Antonelli by 9 points (63 vs 72). Russell is still considered a top contender per FanDuel betting markets, but Antonelli has back-to-back wins. With ~20 races remaining, momentum favours Antonelli but a multi-driver title fight likely. Base rate for the leading-2nd driver winning championship is moderate; estimate ~30-35%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Mercedes vs other teams' development pace through season; reliability of Antonelli's form.
